# Guideline 1 - Stay in the world We would like every round to feel like a real, continuous shift for your character. The more everyone stays in the world, the better it feels for all of us.
- Keep LOOC for real clarifications, not conversation. Chatting can wait for the lobby or the end of the round. - Try not to talk about game mechanics, admins or development in character. - Let events land. Injury, death and danger are not routine for most people, so give them the weight your character would feel.
## Examples Try to avoid: - Responding to a coworker's death with "gg", or looting them straight away without any reaction. - Saying "lol the AI is bolting doors again" over the radio. - Chatting about your day in LOOC while a scene is going on around you.
Try instead: - Having your character freeze, call for help, or take a moment before acting. - Reporting "The AI has sealed the doors, something's wrong, stay calm" in character. - Saving OOC chatter for the lobby or after the round.
